description: Full detail for one provider: profile, rating, and the APIs it publishes. The heavy `collections` and `common` sections are omitted by default (their counts are still reported) — pass view=full for the whole document, or fields=["common"] for a section. Narrow for cheap reads: fields=["score"] returns just the rating. Relative artifact URLs are resolved to absolute, fetchable ones. Results carry `next`: the sub-resources that exist for this entity and the exact tool call that retrieves each, computed from this record. Pass include_next=false to omit it.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

fields.description: Return exactly these top-level keys (slug and name always included); overrides view.

include_next.description: Set false to omit the `next` affordance block.

slug.description: Provider slug — lowercase, hyphenated, as find_providers returns it, e.g. "stripe".

name: get_provider
